channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Draymond Green | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Draymond Green from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Darius Acuff on Draymond Green
item.description:
Darius Acuff on his interaction with Draymond Green the other night:

“He was telling me read the game a little more... He's playing against, but he's also watching the game, trying to teach me. I was listening... I agreed with him.”

Darius Acuff on Draymond Green, Oct 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Grant Williams on Allen Iverson, Boris Diaw, Chuck Hayes, Draymond Green
item.description:
Grant Williams on collecting NBA trading cards:

“Allen Iverson, his market has just ballooned over the past year and a half, two years. So that was pretty cool. And then last but not least, I'm actually auctioning one of my two Allen Iverson cards in an auction here in the next couple weeks, which is exciting. I think I had a smaller Chuck Hayes card, which is kind of embarrassing to say. Listen, I love players that were my size and were playing in the league. So like Chuck Hayes, Draymond Green, Boris Diaw, those were like my favorite players growing up because they looked like me and gave me a chance.”

Grant Williams on Allen Iverson, Boris Diaw, Chuck Hayes, Draymond Green, Sep 27, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Draymond Green
item.description:
Steph Curry:

“It's health. I mean, I missed so many games last year. We got KP, Al, Draymond, guys who know how to win big games when it matters. And for us, if we can stay healthy, have a consistent lineup as much as possible throughout the regular season, I feel like we showed enough last year. And when guys are missing, you saw how much it hurt. Every team needs health on their side. I think some more than others. And I know everybody's working to prepare themselves for the gauntlet of the NBA season coming up.”

Stephen Curry on Draymond Green, Sep 25, 2026. Source: Sirius XM.

item.title: Mike Dunleavy on Draymond Green
item.description:
Dunleavy appreciated Green’s flexibility and reiterated that as Golden State seeks to keep its two future Hall of Famers together until the end.

“Draymond’s been an incredible partner for our organization, both on and off the court, for his career,”

Mike Dunleavy on Draymond Green, Aug 11, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Mike Dunleavy on Draymond Green
item.description:
“This summer was no different with his ability to opt out of the deal;it gave us some wiggle room, some financial flexibility. And we worked together on that, and I don’t think there was ever a doubt he’d be back, but he’s always been about the team … he’s no different than Steph in the sense of we hope he retires a Warrior. We want to make that happen, he wants to make it happen, so we’ll see where things go. Our No. 1 priority right now, Draymond will say this, Steph will say this, everybody here will say this, is to win.”

Mike Dunleavy on Draymond Green, Aug 11, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Draymond Green
item.description:
“So we go to a little dive bar after work all the time and Dray went with me that night. And so I’m not even paying attention because I don’t do the internet. I don’t do internet sh*t. So I fly and I land and I got 100 messages. I’m like what, somebody got traded or something. And then it was about the Draymond stuff and I was like, ‘I never even gave that a second thought,’ but I was really surprised how many people went after Draymond and defended me. I’m not sensitive at all because I say stuff about players. I hope they’re not sensitive because if I say it I believe it, that don’t mean I’m always right. So that didn’t even phase me whatsoever. I can take it as much as I can dish it out.”

Charles Barkley on Draymond Green, Jul 18, 2026. Source: Awful Announcing.

item.title: Tristan Thompson on Draymond Green
item.description:
Tristan Thompson:

“If they win that (in 2016), Draymond Green get MVP. He had 30, 10, and 10 or something like that.”

Tristan Thompson on Draymond Green, Jul 6, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Yaxel Lendeborg on Draymond Green, Lajae Jones
item.description:
When Lendeborg was asked whether he had heard from Steph Curry, Draymond Green, or any of the other Warriors veterans since being drafted, he said,

“Yeah. Steph actually welcomed both of us in the group chat, the night of the draft. when [Lajae Jones] got drafted [and] I got drafted.“And I reached out to [Curry] yesterday, and I asked him a quick question. And then I reached out to Draymond, as well. Haven’t gotten that response back yet from Draymond yet,”

Yaxel Lendeborg on Draymond Green, Lajae Jones, Jun 27, 2026. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Nick Young on Draymond Green
item.description:
Nick Young:

“Steph is like the good cop to Draymond's bad cop. You got to have that kind of balance. Being Draymond's being Draymond, Steph will pull you to the side and be like, 'Don't worry about that, just continue to play, things going to work out.' So he's a good dude. And KD, he don't really he's not really the leader type like the captain type. He leads by just being on the floor, but he's not really too vocal unless he kind of know you.”

Nick Young on Draymond Green, Jun 21, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: LeBron James on Draymond Green
item.description:
NBA Courtside:LeBron James says Josh Hart is like a wild card:

“He’s one of those few guys in our league that makes an impact and it doesn’t have to always be scoring. It’s the Draymond Green role where you know he gets you 8 points but it’s 12 rebounds. It’s 7 assists. It’s diving for loose ball’s, some the stuff that don’t show up in the box scores, you know. It’s that competitive will, you know, and if you disrespect him he can obviously make shots as well.”

LeBron James on Draymond Green, Jun 9, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Draymond Green, Rudy Gobert
item.description:
Dwyane Wade:

“Draymond Green walked up on me before and had a conversation. He didn't like what I said in the Olympics about something. It was about Rudy Gobert. It was about Rudy Gobert and I know we had to have that conversation and I had to express with him like, hold on, I got a job. I got a role. I'm on the government side of the Utah Jazz. I want Rudy Gobert to do. Yes, I want the US to win. But also I want to see Rudy Gobert had success. And we said there had that combo and I appreciated that because he came up to me about, hey, I didn't like how you said this and I was like, respect now, let's talk about it. So as long as it go that way and we could talk about how you received it.”

Dwyane Wade on Draymond Green, Rudy Gobert, May 20, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Draymond Green
item.description:
“He’s younger than me, but it was Draymond. In my fourth year, can you imagine he was the loudest one in the room, even in his first year? As the relationship grew, it kind of became important for me to make sure I elevated my voice so that he wasn’t the only one that you heard on a daily basis.”

Stephen Curry on Draymond Green, May 15, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Draymond Green
item.description:
‪Oh No He Didn't‬: Kawhi on Draymond:

“Hall of Fame defender. It was hard to even get shots up”

Kawhi Leonard on Draymond Green, Apr 16, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green
item.description:
‪Michael Scotto‬:Steve Kerr on Draymond Green:

“He’s the best defender I’ve ever seen in my life. It’s just insane what he does out there.”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Apr 16, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Draymond Green, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Ty Lue on Kawhi Leonard's fourth quarter struggles:

“I thought Draymond did a good job being physical, denying the basketball, not letting him get to his spots... We didn't execute well with his blitzes.”

Tyronn Lue on Draymond Green, Kawhi Leonard, Apr 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Gary Payton II on Draymond Green
item.description:
Gary Payton II:

“I don’t know about that. They had a decade and some change with each other. I just try to get as much info and intel as I can from both of them to make it easier for the both of them. So I definitely took some things from Draymond with Steph. And I definitely took some things from Steph for Draymond. So to just play off of those guys, they make it very easy on the court on both ends. So as much as I can feed and grab intel from them, it makes my life easier.”

Gary Payton II on Draymond Green, Apr 15, 2026. Source: Responsible Gaming.

item.title: Al Horford on Draymond Green
item.description:
“So in Boston, we ran a lot of pick-and-rolls, and then some isolations, and then we got to moving the ball. And here with the Warriors, we try to get the ball to Draymond (Green), or get the ball in the post, and then play more in the perimeter, play splits and cut to the basket and things like that. “And then when Steph is on the court, obviously all that ties in together. So there’s some pick and roll, but then there’s a lot of off-the-ball movement.”

Al Horford on Draymond Green, Mar 2, 2026. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Draymond Green
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Kristaps Porzingis:

“I love Draymond, man. I can see how important he is to this group.”

Kristaps Porzingis on Draymond Green, Feb 18, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green
item.description:
NBACentral: Steve Kerr says Draymond Green deserves a statue

“[Draymond and I] have talked [about the trade rumors]. I think what's really tricky for Draymond is this is the only place he's ever known. He's going to have a statue outside the building someday.”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Feb 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green
item.description:
Dalton Johnson:Steve Kerr on Draymond Green trade rumors:

“This is the first time since I’ve been here that his name has ever really been mentioned in trade talks,so it’s different.”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Feb 3, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green
item.description:
“I remember we had a game, we were in Memphis late in the year, and I was playing a lot of people in the first half. It was a close game at halftime. I think I played 11, 12 people. Draymond (Green) came to me at halftime and said, ‘Coach, we all want this. Don’t mess around. Let’s go get this.’ That was the mentality of the team.”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Jan 18, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Draymond Green:

“Monday night was not my finest hour and that was a time I needed to be calm in the huddle, and so I regret my actions in that exchange. I apologized to Dray. He apologized to me. We both apologized to the team.”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Dec 24, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Steve Kerr, Draymond Green
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Steph on Draymond and Steve Kerr's exchange:

“They were just having a good conversation. It's kind of for them to talk about not me. I'm pretty sure we know how to be professional though”

Stephen Curry on Steve Kerr, Draymond Green, Dec 23, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Steve Kerr on Draymond interacting with fans courtside during the game:

“As long as it doesn't escalate it's fine to go over and have a discussion. I had no problem with it. It would have been nice if security had gotten there a little bit earlier”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Nov 16, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green
item.description:
Kerr told reporters Friday.

“I think he's seeing the floor better. I just like the approach, I like the vibe that he's bringing. He's confident. He definitely feels like part of the team and what we're trying to do. After all the contract stuff I just think his teammates have been so good, Jimmy [Butler], Steph [Curry], [Draymond Green] all welcoming him back with open arms and reminding him that contract stuff is contract stuff.”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Oct 25, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Draymond Green
item.description:
Curry told EssentiallySports.

“We have some youth that can carry us. Hopefully, we can have a good complement of age and wisdom and youth and energy. But I know with me, Jimmy and Draymond, we all understand the work that goes in behind the scenes with recovery and all that type of stuff. If you want to win a championship, health is a big part of it. Every team that gets to the finish line has health on their side. So you cross your fingers and hope you can get it done.”

Stephen Curry on Draymond Green, Oct 17, 2025. Source: Essentially Sports.

item.title: De'Aaron Fox on Draymond Green
item.description:
Fox specifically zeroed in on the Warriors star Green as the league’s biggest complainer.

“Draymond will clothesline you and then look at the ref like, ‘What’d I do?'”

De'Aaron Fox on Draymond Green, Sep 3, 2025. Source: Larry Brown Sports.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Andre Iguodala, Paul George, Klay Thompson, Draymond Green
item.description:
Beverley revealed he thinks Golden State would have won more than four titles if Paul George replaced Thompson.

“If you put Paul George in that role playing as Klay Thompson, playing with [Steph Curry, Draymond Green, Andre Iguodala] at a point -- obviously we know Paul George a couple years ago, was in the MVP race,”

Patrick Beverley on Andre Iguodala, Paul George, Klay Thompson, Draymond Green, Aug 25, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Chris Finch on Draymond Green
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Wolves coach Chris Finch on the MIN fan who was disciplined by team security for harassing Draymond Green with racially-charged language in Game 2:

“There’s zero place for any of that in sports and societyand I was proud of the way the organization acted swiftly.”

Chris Finch on Draymond Green, May 10, 2025. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Draymond Green nearing the seven-technical one-game suspension (two away):

“He’s going to have to be careful…He’s going to have to stay composed and I’m confident he will because he knows the circumstances.”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, May 9, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.
